releases.name: Spearfish
releases.summary: Spearfish is a short action-adventure game where you spear through and catch fish as a swordfish. Explore open environments and catch a range of creatures from real-life fish to sea beasts.

releases.name: Zili Diary escape against witch
releases.summary: Zili Diary is a psychological horror visual novel. Explore a cursed mall, make life-or-death choices, and fight to survive. Every action costs a piece of your soul.

releases.name: Swarmdle
releases.summary: A survivors-like roguelite. Fight down through three areas, spend what you collect on weapons and upgrades between waves, and keep permanent upgrades when a run ends. Plus a twelve-minute daily run that every player in the world gets identically.

releases.name: Impossible Wonders
releases.summary: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

releases.name: Cube Fold
releases.summary: Cube Fold is a relaxing minimalist puzzle game where every move unfolds the cube into new shapes. Solve handcrafted levels filled with teleporters, jump tiles, moving platforms, bridges, and clever mechanics. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

releases.name: Adverse Reaction
releases.summary: Malpractice never looked this fun. A falling-pill puzzle roguelike where you cure patients, climb a 10-floor hospital, and build runs from 32 prescriptions, five flawed doctors, and no clean bill of health.

releases.name: Survidle Knight
releases.summary: Enter the dungeon. Fight powerful foes. Die. Upgrade. Repeat. Survidle Knight is an idle RPG dungeon crawler with survivor-like elements and no input during gameplay.

releases.name: Apartment 3502
releases.summary: A psychological horror game set in a high-rise apartment building in Japan. You are staying in Room 3501 on the 35th floor when, one night, you encounter something inexplicable. Strange events gradually begin to unfold in what should have been a quiet apartment building...

releases.name: Dreadgence
releases.summary: "You are a NUKE commando, up against a war you did not sign up for but are going for love of Country. You must battle the enemies, bent on flooding the world with more DRUGS for  SWEATY MONEY.Professional music and killer graphics round out this stellar game.  •Earn coins and points and show 'em who the real veteran is. Cold-war like graphics!!  •You can download this right from iTunes App Store--you don’t have to wait on a physical product. •Go ahead, download Nuke Armies right now!"

releases.name: Cozy Cat Room: Focus Time with Your Cat
releases.summary: A cozy companion for work and study. Share your focus time with a cat, decorate your room, and find your rhythm with a flexible timer and gentle music. As you focus, your cat levels up and new furniture and designs become available.

releases.name: Micro Grid: Racing Team Manager
releases.summary: Take a single-seater racing team all the way to the title. Design the car, sign the drivers, read the weather and make the calls from the pit wall. Every race is simulated wheel to wheel, so a well-timed stop or the right tires can swing the result.

releases.name: Idle King: Loot Together
releases.summary: Idle King is a multiplayer idle loot RPG set in a dark fairy-tale world. Choose your hero, battle monsters and bosses, collect gear, and power up with gems. Adventure solo or team up with up to three friends to take on powerful foes and hunt for your ideal gear!Auto-Battle and Keep LootingYour hero fights automatically as the loot piles up. Journey through forests, deserts, and icy landscapes to graveyards and floating islands, facing distinctive monsters and bosses along the way. Choose stages and difficulty levels that match your strength, collect better gear, and push toward tougher challenges.Random Loot, Your Own BuildCollect gear of different rarities, hunt for the perfect affix combinations, and experiment with different builds. Unlock your equipment’s potential with gems and a variety of upgrades, refining your loadout to take on even stronger enemies.Team Up and Loot TogetherPlay solo or join forces in online co-op for up to four players. Bring your own heroes and loadouts, fight side by side, and reap the rewards. Farm gear, grow stronger together, and take down the bosses standing in your way.Push Deeper into the AbyssRandom monster encounters in the Abyss put your build to the test. Each floor brings tougher enemies and the chance to claim even more powerful gear.

releases.name: Orcthal
releases.summary: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies in this 3D survivors-like. Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

releases.name: Hoppernaut
releases.summary: A rabbit, a jetpack and a lot of holes to dig. Collect every capsule, trap the robots, and hop from the launch pad to a black hole and up the Ascent across 37 levels. Three stars per level, ten time-trial sprints, a level editor. Old-school arcade platforming with a modern spring in its step.

releases.name: Desert Survivors
releases.summary: Destroy the endless monsters of the desert and break this curse! Choose your character, combine your abilities, and build your own devastating synergies. Can you withstand the ruthlessness of the desert?

releases.name: IWA Fighting Adventure
releases.summary: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

releases.name: How To Ride Elevators Like A Human
releases.summary: A chill puzzle game about an alien trying to understand one of humanity’s strangest social rules: why does everyone avoid eye contact in elevators?

releases.name: Shift 233
releases.summary: You are a new employee at Station 4 on Shift 233 where you monitor microseismic sensor readings and log events or dismiss them as noise. As you go further, what starts out as a normal shift slowly reveals a strange presence within the cracks of the earth.

releases.name: Tenant Gone!
releases.summary: Turn messy apartments into fresh starts. Collect rubbish, vacuum dust and mop spills, then uncover forgotten cameras, records and collectibles. Bring your finds back to appraise, sell or display as you grow your own little clearance company.

releases.name: Cardboard Leagues
releases.summary: The rookie in your display case just scored a hat trick. Reprice him. You run a sports card shop. Your staff work the register; you work the market — deciding what wax to order, what to slab, what to price up, and which rookie nobody is on yet is worth a shelf.

releases.name: Kern
releases.summary: It's a tower defence game with a skill tree. Play as the pilot that crash the spaceship in the unknown white space. Defend the spaceship from a horde of enemies through multiple stages while fixing the ship to escape from this place.

releases.name: SUPER DURAK
releases.summary: Durak, the Russian card game everyone's grandmother plays, now with Supercards that break the rules. Bomb an attack, ricochet it to a neighbour, steal your rival's best card with a magnet, or reroll the trump. Play CPU opponents, a friend at the same screen, or anyone online.

releases.name: ColorFarm
releases.summary: A cozy farming companion that lives in the corner of your desktop. Earn coins through everyday keyboard and mouse activity, grow colorful plants, turn each harvest into bead-art materials, create freely from patterns, collect your artwork, and expand your own floating farms.

releases.name: Three Kingdoms: Survivors
releases.summary: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.

releases.name: Ninja Kaeru
releases.summary: Strike down relentless waves of enemies and test your reflexes! How long can you survive as the speed keeps rising in this fast-paced retro 8-bit arena?

releases.name: Seaside Scoops
releases.summary: Run a little ice cream truck by the sea. Scoop, stack and top every order by hand, earn tips from happy customers, then spend your days in town: stock up, decorate your home and spoil your pets. A cozy seaside job sim.

releases.name: No One Owns the Light
releases.summary: This is the story of the first person in the world to be put to death in an electric chair.

releases.name: Out Of Hours
releases.summary: A top-down parking sim about the last ten minutes of a fourteen-hour day. The lot is nearly full, the one open stall is between two sleeping rigs, and you have a 53-foot trailer to put in it.

releases.name: Collectible
releases.summary: Build your collection and your card-show business. Open packs, organize binders, negotiate sales and trades, and grow from a flea-market table to a national-show booth in this first-person card collecting simulator.

releases.name: Oh Shear!
releases.summary: Grab your shears and build a cozy wool empire! Oh Shear! is a relaxing incremental game about managing a colorful flock of sheep. Upgrade your tools, automate the pasture, and master the skill tree. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the 'shear satisfaction' of numbers going up!

releases.name: Train Goes Choo Choo
releases.summary: A nostalgic window into Japanese slice-of-life, perfect for those who find peace in the quiet beauty of rural landscapes and the rhythmic flow of a journey. Just enjoy the view.

releases.name: Cooking Adventure
releases.summary: Cook, serve, and upgrade your way through a fast-paced 2D time management cooking game rebuilt for PC. Master recipes, manage busy stations, satisfy quirky customers, and chase high scores across colorful restaurants.

releases.name: EmergenHex
releases.summary: Solve combat puzzles with your build-crafted loadout, automate conquered nodes across a haunted hex map for loot, and upgrade your skills, passives, and gear. Master 70+ handcrafted encounters, then enter a harder phase where the rules change for all encounters!

releases.name: Uncosy
releases.summary: An uncomfortable game about collecting plushies.

releases.name: Core Logistics
releases.summary: Core Logistics is a management sim about growing a transport company from a single van into a network that spans the whole map. Read the freight market, commit a finite fleet to the jobs worth taking, and match the right trucks and licenses to each load. And when you need to think — just hit pause.

releases.name: The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe
releases.summary: Take my order, brother! The Demon Lord's Maid Cafe is a short cafe-themed incremental game about feeding slimes in a Maid Cafe. Buy upgrades, feed slimes, and take your Maid Cafe to the top.
